question.prompt: The minute hand of a clock is 8 cm long and rotates for 45 minutes (the minute hand rotates \(6^\circ\) per minute). The tip travels an arc length of \(k\pi\) cm. Find the value of \(k\).

solutions.explanation: The angle of rotation is \(45\times 6=270^\circ\). The arc length is \(l=270\pi\times 8/180=12\pi\), so \(k=12\).
solutions.title: Rotation angle and arc length
